title: 耶鲁研究员：罗斯福如何对抗JP摩根，历史警示今日
speaker: William D. Cohan

segments.en: But when I have power, then I'm above the law, then I'm above everything else.
segments.zh: 但当我拥有权力时，我就凌驾于法律之上，凌驾于一切之上。

segments.en: But the United States has dealt with this issue before.
segments.zh: 但美国以前处理过这个问题。

segments.en: And so theater Roosevelt and JP Morgan, when Roosevelt began to investigate JP Morgan's trust and his sort of sort of control of the US economy.
segments.zh: 所以西奥多·罗斯福和JP摩根，当罗斯福开始调查摩根的信托及其对美国经济的控制时。

segments.en: And while Morgan himself was not that rich, his financial network was such that he really did have a level of control over the US economy that probably no individual today approaches.
segments.zh: 虽然摩根本人并非那么富有，但他的金融网络使他确实对美国经济拥有一定程度的控制，这种程度今天可能无人能及。

segments.en: Morgan said to Roosevelt, if you have a problem with what I am doing, have your man meet my man.
segments.zh: 摩根对罗斯福说，如果你对我的所作所为有意见，让你的人和我的人谈谈。

segments.en: And tell us what we're doing wrong.
And by your man, he met the attorney general.
segments.zh: 他所说的“你的人”指的是司法部长。

segments.en: So JP Morgan, as you know, theater Roosevelt himself said, say that JP Morgan could not see theater Roosevelt as anything other but a rival operator of another big firm.
segments.zh: 所以JP摩根，如你所知，西奥多·罗斯福本人曾说，摩根只能将罗斯福视为另一家大公司的竞争对手。
